newsitem.title: USA: DH Technology sees Q4 net $0.40/shr.
newsitem.headline: DH Technology sees Q4 net $0.40/shr.

text.p: DH Technology Inc said Wednesday it expects net income for the fourth quarter to be about $3.4 million, or $0.40 per share.
Revenues are expected to be about $29 million.
The company said the projections are in line with analysts' estimates.
For the prior year's fourth quarter the company posted net income of $2.8 million, or $0.33 per share, on revenues of $26 million.
For the full year 1996, the company said it expects to report net income of about $13.1 million, or $1.54 per share, on revenues of about $116 million.
DH Technology designs, manufactures and distributes a variety of printers and related products.
